ModMetaData.name: Animal Genetics: Breeding Program
ModMetaData.author: IyedBecheikh
ModMetaData.description:
Run a real breeding program on top of Animal Genetics (Continued). Pick who breeds, protect your best lines, cull the worst, bank genes, and tune the next generation.
[b]Herd management[/b] - Breeding goals per species (pack animal, meat, milk/wool/eggs, war beast, docile, balanced, or custom weights) turn each animal's genes into one Breeding Score. - Herd roles: Breeder, Keep, Cull. Set them from a gizmo, the Animals / Genetics tabs, or the Breeding Program window. - Mating control per species: open breeding, breeder males only, or the best N males by score. Cull animals never breed. - Gene-aware auto-slaughter: vanilla still decides how many go, this mod decides which. Breeders and Keeps are protected, worst genes go first. Optional: protect the top N per sex, always slaughter Culls, cull adults below a score.
[b]Breeding insight[/b] - Pedigree tab: three generations with every ancestor's genes and the inbreeding coefficient. - Pairings view: predicted child genes and score for any sire x dam, odds of beating the parents or your best animal, and the best pairs in the herd. - Optional inbreeding depression (off by default).
[b]Germline banking[/b] (research: germline banking) - Collect germline samples from males, keep them in a powered cryobank, inseminate females later, even after the donor is gone. Works for egg-layers too. - Health-tab operations for collecting, inseminating (best matching sample) and giving serums, plus gizmos to pick an exact sample. - Storage filters that sort fertilized eggs by gene quality.
[b]Germline tuning[/b] (research: germline tuning) - Serums: dominance (one gene always from the better parent), stabilizing (less mutation), mutagenic (more mutation). - Gene splice: move one gene from a donor sample into a target sample at the cryobank.
[b]Vanilla Genetics Expanded (optional)[/b] - Genomes remember the animal they came from, and hybrids inherit those real genes instead of random ones. - Research moves to VGE's genetics tab; the VGE genetics trader buys and sells germline samples and serums.
[b]Performance[/b] - Fixes the Genetics / Wildlife / Animals tab lag with many animals (about 3x faster drawing, no constant rebuilds). Works with Numbers and Animal Tab.
Safe to add to an existing save. Requires Harmony and Animal Genetics (Continued).
